question: Which of the following values can replace K in 7(3)/(5) times 4(1)/(2) - {{K}} {{ = }} {{26}}(3)/(4)?x = {-b pm sqrt{b²-4ac} over 2a}
solution:
Given:

7(3)/(5) times 4(1)/(2) - {{K}} {{ = }} {{26}}(3)/(4)

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eafd54de9d9fc295c072d1fa0b8367ee3ed24189b7ad133a51c29266134693c4.png] 

Calculation:

7(3)/(5) times 4(1)/(2) - {{K}} {{ = }} {{26}}(3)/(4)

⇒ {{38} over 5} times {9 over 2} - K = {107 over 4}

⇒ 342 over 10 - {107 over 4} = K

⇒ K = {684 - 535} over 20

⇒ K = 149 over 20

⇒ K = 7(9)/({20)}

**∴ 7(9)/({20)} can replace K in 7(3)/(5) times 4(1)/(2) - {{K}} {{ = }} {{26}}(3)/(4).**
